after_contact.note: The bag stopped on the board and was still there when the clip ended (resting at the lip of the hole).

end.note: The bag stopped on the board and was still there when the clip ended (resting at the lip of the hole).

lateral.note: Left/right on the board is approximate from a side camera (about ±3 in): the across direction runs along the camera's line of sight. The result is decided from the along-board position; the board camera measures left/right precisely.

slide.reason: Effective kinetic friction for a bag sliding up the deck, from a constant-deceleration fit. Fitted on the plain deck before the hole.

suggested_outcome.basis: The bag stopped on the board and was still there when the clip ended (resting at the lip of the hole). It stopped at the hole.
